title: TOTAL WASTE OF MONEY. Item arrived without any hardware or support posts.
text:
TOTAL WASTE OF MONEY. Item arrived without any hardware or support posts.. Impossible to assemble because NONE of the HARDWARE NOR SUPPORT POSTS WERE INCLUDED in the box. The Nexel shelf unit was a TOTAL WASTE OF MONEY and it was VERY OVERPRICED for the POOR QUALITY of the product.

Since the wire shelves DON'T have any special magical powers and they aren't capable of levitating on their own, I highly suggest that you purchase a shelf unit that does come with the hardware and support posts. ☺️

product_metadata.title: Nexel 21" x 24" x 74", 4 Tier, NSF Listed Adjustable Wire Shelving, Unit Commercial Storage Rack, Silver Epoxy, Leveling feet
features: Silver epoxy finish consists of a silver epoxy powder coat over a rust inhibiting undercoat
Shelves easily adjust without tools and align accurately at 1" increments. Shelf clips snap on post, allowing shelf collar to slide over for a secure fit
Shelves easily adjust without tools and align accurately at 1" increments. Reinforced shelves with welded surface ribs for added strength, 800 lb shelf capacity.
Silver Epoxy Wire Shelving is NSF listed and can be used in either wet or dry storage areas, coolers and freezers
description: NEXEL's shelving is used across the country for foodservice, healthcare, commercial, industrial and consumer applications and is the strongest shelving in the industry. Silver Epoxy Starter Units feature an attractive finish that consists of a Silver Epoxy powder-coat over a rust inhibiting undercoat. NSF approved for wet or dry use. Starter Unit includes 4 posts with leveling feet, 4 wire shelves and plastic snap on sleeves to secure shelves to posts. Features: Reinforced shelves with welded surface ribs for added strength. Open design to maximize air and light circulation and minimize dust accumulation. Includes 4 posts, 4 shelves and snap on sleeves. Shelves easily adjust without tools at 1" increments. NSF approved for wet or dry use. Limited seven year warranty against rust and corrosion.
